question: List the foreign names and languages of all Story Spotlight cards that have unknown power (* or NULL) and are legal in the Commander format. Exclude any card that is also banned in the Gladiator format.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_079", T3."XCL_077"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_082"
WHERE T1."XCL_034" = 1
  AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_072" NOT IN (
    SELECT "XCL_086" FROM legalities
    WHERE "XCL_084" = 'gladiator' AND "XCL_085" = 'Banned'
  )
